help_center_articles.title: Missing hardware and spare parts
help_center_articles.snippet: What to do when fittings like dowels, cam locks, screws, or shelf pins are missing from a flat-pack box, and how to order free spare parts.
facts: Common fittings: wooden dowel 101350, cam lock 110630, cam screw 109049, shelf pin 371813.
Spare parts are free and arrive in 3 to 5 business days.
help_center_articles.next_step: Find the part number in the assembly manual diagram and order free spares under Support > Spare Parts.

help_center_articles.title: Kallax assembly and stability
help_center_articles.snippet: Help for Kallax shelving that is unstable, wobbles, rocks from side to side, or will not sit square after assembly, including fitting the cam locks.
facts: A Kallax 2x2 unit is 77 by 77 centimeters and uses 16 cam locks.
Assembly takes about 30 minutes for one person.
help_center_articles.next_step: Confirm cam locks are inserted with the arrow toward the panel edge, then quarter-turn to lock. For a wobbly unit: loosen all cams, square the frame on a flat floor, and retighten in a cross pattern.

help_center_articles.title: Kallax inserts and doors
help_center_articles.snippet: Which drawer inserts, door inserts, and accessories fit Kallax cubes, and how to install them.
facts: All standard inserts (drawer, door, shelf) fit every 33 by 33 centimeter Kallax cube opening.
Each insert ships with its own screws and needs only a Phillips screwdriver.
help_center_articles.next_step: Verify the unit generation on the label under the top panel, then confirm the insert type before ordering.

help_center_articles.title: Strandmon legs and footstool
help_center_articles.snippet: Help for Strandmon wingback chairs with loose, cracked, uneven, or creaking legs, and for ordering the matching footstool.
facts: The Strandmon wingback chair is 82 wide, 96 deep, and 101 centimeters high.
The legs screw on by hand with no tools.
The matching footstool is a separate item in the same fabrics.
help_center_articles.next_step: Have the caller flip the chair and hand-tighten each leg fully. For an uneven or creaking chair, check that the leg plates sit flush.

help_center_articles.title: Choosing an armchair
help_center_articles.snippet: Helping a caller choose between the wingback Strandmon and the lighter Poang, including fabrics, sizes, and matching footstools.
facts: Strandmon is a high-back wingback armchair; Poang is a lighter bentwood armchair that also comes in a rocking version.
Both lines offer fabric and leather options and have matching footstools.
Strandmon is 82 wide, 96 deep, and 101 centimeters high; Poang is 68 by 82 by 100.
help_center_articles.next_step: Ask about the room, the preferred sitting position, and fabric, then check stock at the caller's nearest store.

help_center_articles.title: Poang cushions and covers
help_center_articles.snippet: Ordering and replacing Poang armchair cushions and covers, and checking which covers fit which frame.
facts: Poang cushions come in Knisa, Skiftebo, and Gunnared fabrics plus Glose leather.
The cushion model is on the label under the seat.
Covers ship in 3 to 5 business days.
help_center_articles.next_step: Confirm the frame type (standard or rocking) and the cushion model from the label under the seat.

help_center_articles.title: Choosing shelving and storage
help_center_articles.snippet: Helping a caller pick a shelving or storage line, from Kallax cube units to Billy bookcases and Besta or Eket wall storage.
facts: Kallax cube units work as open shelving or room dividers and take drawer and door inserts.
Billy bookcases suit books and display shelving.
Besta and Eket are wall-mountable storage lines for living rooms.
help_center_articles.next_step: Ask what the caller wants to store and where it will go, then suggest one line and check stock nearby.

help_center_articles.title: Choosing a couch
help_center_articles.snippet: Helping a caller choose between the Ektorp, Kivik, Klippan, and Vimle couch lines and the Friheten sleeper.
facts: Ektorp is a classic couch with washable covers; Kivik is a deeper lounge couch.
Klippan is a compact two-seater; Vimle is a modular line that can grow over time.
Friheten converts to a bed and has storage under the seat.
help_center_articles.next_step: Ask about the room size, how many seats are needed, and whether it should convert to a bed, then check stock nearby.

help_center_articles.title: Choosing a desk or table
help_center_articles.snippet: Helping a caller choose a desk, dining table, or side table across the Linnmon, Micke, Norden, and Lack lines.
facts: Linnmon tabletops pair with Alex drawer units for a customizable desk.
Micke is a compact desk with built-in cable management.
Norden covers dining tables and Lack covers side and coffee tables.
help_center_articles.next_step: Ask whether it is for working, dining, or display and how much space there is, then suggest one line and check stock nearby.

help_center_articles.title: Damaged item replacement
help_center_articles.snippet: What to do when an item arrives cracked, scratched, dented, or broken, and how to get a replacement part without returning the whole unit.
facts: Single panels and parts are replaceable for all frame products.
Processing needs the order number, the part's position number from the manual, and a photo.
A full-unit return is not needed.
help_center_articles.next_step: Ask for the order number and the part's position number from the assembly manual, then arrange a replacement.

help_center_articles.title: Dimensions and fit
help_center_articles.snippet: Product and package dimensions and weights, and whether flat-pack boxes fit in a car or through a doorway.
facts: Billy 80 centimeter: assembled 80 by 28 by 202, package 209 by 39 by 12 at 33 kilograms.
Kallax 2x2: assembled 77 by 77 by 39, package 91 by 41 by 16 at 24 kilograms.
Strandmon: assembled 82 by 96 by 101, package 63 by 72 by 30 at 17 kilograms.
Poang: assembled 68 by 82 by 100, package 122 by 62 by 12 at 10 kilograms.
Standard sedans fit boxes up to about 200 centimeters diagonally.
help_center_articles.next_step: Quote assembled and flat-pack package dimensions separately; multi-box items list each box.

help_center_articles.title: Delivery and order status
help_center_articles.snippet: Checking where a delivery is, rescheduling the delivery window, and tracing a missing box from a multi-box order.
facts: Deliveries book in 4 hour windows and rescheduling is free up to 24 hours before.
Multi-box orders are tracked per box, and a missing box triggers a trace and reshipment.
help_center_articles.next_step: Look up the order by number or the email on the account, then verify the per-box scan status.

help_center_articles.title: Returns and refunds
help_center_articles.snippet: Return windows, what condition items need to be in, and how refunds are issued for store and delivery purchases.
facts: Unopened items can be returned within 365 days and opened items within 180 days with proof of purchase.
Refunds go back to the original payment method.
Large items can be returned at a store or collected for a fee.
help_center_articles.next_step: Confirm proof of purchase and whether the item is assembled, then book a store return or a pickup.

help_center_articles.title: Assembly instructions and manuals
help_center_articles.snippet: Finding the printed or PDF assembly manual for any product and getting step-by-step help putting it together.
facts: Every manual is printed in the box and available as a PDF under Support > Assembly Guides or via the QR code on the box.
Typical assembly takes 20 to 60 minutes.
help_center_articles.next_step: Locate the manual via Support > Assembly Guides or the QR code on the box; for a lost manual, send the PDF link by email.

help_center_articles.title: Store hours, locations, and contact
help_center_articles.snippet: Store opening hours, holiday exceptions, finding the nearest store, and how to reach customer support.
facts: Stores are open 10:00 AM to 9:00 PM Monday through Saturday and 10:00 AM to 6:00 PM on Sundays; hours vary on public holidays.
Customer support is available 8:00 AM to 8:00 PM daily by phone and chat.
help_center_articles.next_step: Share the local store's hours and confirm the caller's nearest location.

help_center_articles.title: Choosing a bed
help_center_articles.snippet: Helping a caller choose a bed frame for adults or children across the Tarva, Kura, and Sniglar lines.
facts: Tarva is a solid pine bed frame that can be painted or stained.
Kura is a reversible children's bed that works low or as a loft.
Sniglar is a toddler bed with a low height for easy climbing.
help_center_articles.next_step: Ask who the bed is for and the mattress size, then suggest one line and check stock nearby.
